Issue

The signup and password reset pages ignore the accent colour from the selected theme.

Actual Behavior

When a theme is applied, the divider keeps its default colour instead of inheriting the accent.

Screenshot

Expected Behavior

The divider inherits the accent colour of the selected theme.

https://www.example.com/design/spec?node-id=42&m=dev

Testing Steps

  1. Go to the signup page
  2. Confirm the divider uses the accent colour of the theme.
  3. Confirm text, spacing and layout are unchanged.
  4. Check desktop, tablet and mobile.
